observations: Plan testerAdditions[1] as written does not run: `docker run … -u 1003:1003 -v "$LEGION_WORKSPACE":"$LEGION_WORKSPACE":ro -w …/packages/workspace <D> test …` prints `No tests found!` because the image's /home/legion belongs to uid 1000 and uid 1003 cannot traverse it, so bun's discovery finds nothing under the deep path. Mounting packages/workspace at /work (same -u and HOME=/tmp) runs it, as does the image's default user (uid 1000) at the deep path. Same test, same image; recorded as a deviation on the PR comment.

Acceptance 5's digest identity moves with every handoff commit: the branch tip 2535f0a9 published sha256:86a4e93f… for the same code as c336112c's sha256:ba1b0242…; the final `.legion/` deletion will publish yet another. The proofs ran on the code head's digest; the reviewer/merger should read acceptance 5 as 'the digest of the code head', not of the momentary branch tip.

The resumed architect on the kind run wrote a plan artifact to LEGSMOKE-208 (an `artifact.version` event appeared before I closed the issue) — the resurrected session was live and working, not merely registered.
